tasks.instruction: StepFun standard OpenAI-compatible Chat reports usage.cached_tokens as a subset of inclusive prompt_tokens. Recognize this field only when trusted provider context is stepfun or stepfun-cn and both request and response formats are openai.chat_completions. Thread the same context through JSON and cumulative SSE usage extraction. Preserve inclusive input totals, existing cache-evidence conflict validation, and every other provider and format; response model names alone must not grant this interpretation.

Abliteration server authentication must recognize its canonical ABLIT_KEY while retaining compatibility with ABLITERATION_API_KEY. Prefer the canonical key when both are configured, accept either server key for readiness and operation configuration, and preserve account-owner credential selection and runtime binding. Do not require both names or change unrelated provider authentication.

Trusted selected Google native speech/music models must remain explicitly unpriced in direct pricing and reservation paths until output-audio tariffs and measured usage are qualified. Apply the shared output-audio classification before treating a supplied text, zero-rate or foreign image price card as sufficient. Preserve ordinary Google text and image pricing and the existing responseModalities audio guard.

Represent MiniMax Music availability observations separately for global and CN regions. Both paid families are limited to existing paying users, with new paid users denied since 2026-08-20. Global free Music has an announced discontinuation without a confirmed date; CN free Music is stopped. Use region-specific documentation sources and checkedAt 2026-11-05. These observations must not grant account entitlement, invent tariffs, change routing origins or enable native Music execution.
